observed_claims: README lists optimized Ampere/Ada/Hopper kernels, Blackwell FP4 in a separate directory.
README recommends SageAttention2 for precision-sensitive applications.
Attention TOPS excludes quantization and smoothing; this is not end-to-end latency.

decision: SageBwd's 2026 result concerns trainable attention/pretraining. Abstract/metadata reviewed only; not evidence of a SAM3 PTQ or SM75 inference improvement. Continue native SM75 attention scope measurements; mean-K smoothing is a separate possible hypothesis, not implemented or verified here.
